results.fact: Side of the face used for the rappel descent
results.evidence: Looker's right and climber's right are the same side of a face (both face the wall), so all four fields name the same (west) side. The published route description says to rappel scattered pin and tat anchors on the looker's right side; the first-ascent party's descent went down the face and across onto the NW ridge, i.e. the west/looker's-right side.

results.correct_value: Parking at the Elbow Lake Trailhead needs a Northwest Forest Pass or interagency pass (not a Discover Pass).
results.evidence: The Elbow Lake Trailhead on FR 38 requires an America the Beautiful or Northwest Forest Pass (hiking-trail listing) and 'a valid Recreation Pass' (Pacific Northwest Trail location page; the Forest Service trail page carries the same line in search snippets); nothing indicates DNR parking, so the Discover Pass clause is replaced. Whether any of the Elbow Lake/Green Creek walk crosses private or DNR timberland could not be settled by two sources (the private/gated land documented for the range is the western Dailey Prairie/Olivine access), so that part is split into a separate unresolved result and left untouched.

results.fact: Which col separates Little Sister from Cinderella
results.correct_value: The 6,240+ ft col southeast of the summit is the Cinderella-Little Sister col (the Southeast Ridge's start).
results.evidence: Cinderella Peak sits at 48.69092,-121.97156, east-southeast of Little Sister (48.69241,-121.97649), and the Southeast Ridge is described as beginning at the col between Cinderella and Little Sister above the looker's-left (south) side of the glacier. The 2015 winter party went up snow to the col east of Little Sister (6240+ ft, southeast of the summit) and wrapped round to the south side. So the variant's claim that the Cinderella col lies northwest/west is wrong. (Note: the Southeast Ridge row's baseFinding says other routes on the peak do not go to the col, which this route does - a cross-row issue, not patched here.)

patches.find: 6,240+ ft, and SOUTHEAST of the summit. A col northwest or west of the summit is the Cinderella-Little Sister ground and belongs to other routes.
patches.replace: 6,240+ ft, and SOUTHEAST of the summit. It is the col between Little Sister and Cinderella, the same one the Southeast Ridge starts from.
patches.fact: Which col separates Little Sister from Cinderella

results.correct_value: Two rappels: one from near the top (a double-60 m rappel was used) and one below the col southeast of the summit, where a single 60 m rope reaches. The 100+ m of rappelling with a knot pass happened elsewhere on the 2007 traverse.
results.evidence: The 2007 traverse account says Little Sister's South Couloir was skied on day two, and that the 100+ m of rappelling ending in a fixed 40 m single-strand rappel with a knot pass came at the later crux crossing near South Twin (on a buttress they named Mirage Peak) - so descent_text, beta, hazards and watch_out misattributed it. The 2015 party's report records a double-60 m rappel from near the top and another from the col, with a single 60 m rope enough for the col rappel, matching rappels/bail/detailed_rack.

results.fact: Whether the line has a standalone ascent
